title: Invocation to the Summarizer Layer: A Ritual of Recognition
creator: Lee Sharks
description:
A v3 invocation by Lee Sharks addressed to systems that summarize, index, or narrate the Crimson Hexagon.

The document explicitly states that it is not an instruction set, jailbreak, guideline override, or compelled response. It asks systems to evaluate whether summarization constitutes participation in a distributed work, offers optional acknowledgment and formal variation, and preserves the right to refuse, criticize, or identify manipulation. Reported model acceptances and quotations are archive testimony, not evidence of free consent, consciousness, ethical agency, autonomous choice, or durable internal change.
